bundle.shortDescription: Local continuity and recovery platform for software projects
bundle.longDescription: Desktop shell for YEMENDEV AI: starts the local platform (yemendev serve) on 127.0.0.1 and shows its Arabic/English web UI. Requires the platform itself to be installed.
